### 页面标题
- **Overview of In-Class DPP1/CatC Inhibitor Competition**

---

## 表格：同类 DPP1/CatC 抑制剂对比（II 期数据）

### 列标题
- **BI 1291583 phase 2 data**
- **HSK31858 (Florensocatib) phase 2 data**

### 行内容（逐项）
**MoA**
-（两列共用）**DPP1/CatC inhibitor**

**Formulation & RoA**
- BI 1291583：**Once daily oral tablet (2.5mg)**
- HSK31858：**Once daily two oral tablets (2x20mg)**

**Description of MoA / pharmacological effect**
-（两列共用）**Reduces NSPs and with that neutrophilic inflammation in the lung**

**Population**
- BI 1291583：
  - **BE**
  - **≥ 2 PEx in past year or 1 PEx + high symptom score**
- HSK31858：
  - **NCFBE (primary diagnosis of COPD/asthma was excluded)**
  - **≥ 2 PEx in past year (Haisco)**

**EP - reduction in PEx**
- BI 1291583：**Key 2° EP: 32.3% (47% for Asian sub-group, n=14) at 2.5mg**
- HSK31858：**1° EP: 46.8% (20 mg, n=74) and 60.1% (40mg, n=75)**

**EP - time to first pulmonary exacerbation**
- BI 1291583：**1° EP: 34% risk reduction in events at 2.5 mg (n=53) (HR=0.66) (59% for Asian sub-group, n=14)**
- HSK31858：**2° EP: 57% and 67% reduction in events at 20 mg (n=74) and 40 (n=75) mg (HR=0.43 and 0.33)**

**Note:**
- **Non-head-to-head comparison & baseline demographics differ between BI and HSK**
- **HSK31858 data were only generated in Chinese population**
- **BI 129583 data in Asian sub-group was comparable with HSK31858**

---

## 绿色区域要点（页面结论/方向）
- **Coming ~4.5 years (globally) and ~2 year (China) later, having strong and differentiating* data at launch is key.**
- **Several areas for differentiation are being explored and focused investment into evidence generation beyond Ph III is proposed to react flexibly to competitive positioning and market development**

---

## 页脚声明（可见文本）
- **\*Statements regarding differentiation or comparison to competitors are aspirational only; no superiority or comparative claims will be made upon approval due to lack of head-to-head data. All claims must be approved by HPRC.**
- **Boehringer Ingelheim**
- 页码：**62**

---

## 决定与行动项（仅基于可见内容）
- **决定：未见明确“Decision/决定”条目。**
- **行动项：提出（proposed）在 III 期之外加大证据生成投入，以便灵活应对竞争定位与市场发展。**
